# PKG-HERO-SINGLE — Framing (frozen)

```text
shot_id:            PKG-HERO-SINGLE
frozen:             2026-08-12
applies_to:         golden-jiuzhou
```

## Subject

Single SKU, closed-state. No open box. The packaging is the
subject; at most 1 contextual prop may be present (a single
stem, a single stone, a single piece of fabric — not multiple).

## Framing

- Three-quarter product view.
- Packaging occupies **≥ 60 %** of the frame.
- Brand mark is **fully visible** and **unobstructed**.
- Negative space (background) is a calm tone, not a busy
  pattern.

## Aspect ratio

Preferred `4:5` (portrait). `1:1` acceptable.

## Lighting

- Soft studio.
- Single key + bounce.
- No harsh shadow.
- Reveals the substrate texture (Material Quality axis).

## Reference fidelity

- Substrate texture matches the Locked Asset.
- Color ratio matches the Golden baseline (65-70 / 20-25 /
  5-10 / 局部高光).
- Structural edges match the Locked packaging structure
  (天地盖硬盒 or similar).

## Axis weight

- Brand Fidelity, Structure Fidelity, Visual Direction
  Fidelity, Composition Quality, Material Quality, Reference
  Fidelity — all weighted per `acceptance-rubric.json`.
- Series Consistency is N/A (not a series shot).
